notes.title: The Great Egg Hunt
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37752624/7fb374485d06cd8efb716f0c636d2ce079f341e5.png[/img]

Spring has come to the world of Cards&Crystals once again. Six eggs have been hidden throughout the world. Can you spot them and - more importantly - can you beat their guardians?

But you need to hurry. Blubellie is on the lookout as well, and in spite of its seemingly lazy disposition, it can be quite agile when it comes to food.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37752624/05bd66a09ff17a3452e8dc1b13d3045cb4b7b34d.png[/img]

Find the eggs before Blubellie does and you can earn seven eggsclusive promo cards. Eggs proteggt you from enemy attacks - and if you proteggt them long enough, something will hatch!

Now go on an egg hunt with Blubellie! After all, it loves you* as well.
If you need a hint, look in the FAQ in the forums.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37752624/d49c233c43cc47469e6c68cbfc87c93601aa93a0.png[/img]

*offer conditional on provision of sufficient amounts of food, void where illegal by animal husbandry laws

notes.title: Shattered Winter Star
notes.notes:
Winter has returned once again to the world of Cards&Crystals. But the snow isn't the only thing that fell from the sky. Unfortunately, Blubellie has found the fallen Winter Star first, and promptly broke it into six pieces. Search the lands and gather them to reforge the shattered star!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37752624/7f23b9679661da53b41b2a9fb9b4b53364524a6f.png[/img]
The holidays are a time of giving and the battlegrounds are littered with presents. Crack them open and get some help in defeating your opponents.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37752624/bb2733651bfeeef046312fd0774854667535a969.png[/img]
Collect all shards of the Winter Star until January 5th to win an exclusive [b]Reforged Star[/b] card.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37752624/31b12dff907c1edf636b7c5b4ae6075d45f9ed03.png[/img]
[b]
Blubellie, Iriadhis and the Cards&Crystals team wish you all sweet holidays![/b]

notes.title: Reign of the Harvest Queen
notes.notes:
Harvest time is upon us again! While last year was spooky, this year belongs to a beauty.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37752624/092a5f80ba2da8006d1265138df88acca5e689d8.png[/img]

The Harvest Queen embodies the grace of autumn. But don't underestimate the punch that fruits  & flowers pack. She's a formidable opponent.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37752624/d66febe0ef3c15919c4660c6f74f3124ea1b0c9b.png[/img]

Should you defeat her, you can win her card and one of her gardener companions.

P.S.: Don't worry, Boobellie will return next year! (as soon as we can afford to cut up another bedsheet...)

notes.title: The Tree Of Many
notes.notes:
Summer time is here and fruits grow all over Relegatia.  To get them, all you have to do is defeat their guardians ...err... gardeners. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37752624/6433b3a0215754ef3f41c39873f067cd043c3aa0.png[/img]

[b]15 new fruit cards[/b] should provide lots of help in building dual-elemental decks, So collect them all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37752624/d8060db880464f3fcfe54f6dad8f08d07bab23cd.png[/img]

Should you gather them all, a final challenge awaits. The enigmatic [b]Tree Of Many[/b] is hard to fell, as it can only be damaged by its own element. So figure it out or Blubellie will mock you for getting beaten up by a tree.

Enjoy the summer!

P.S.: A very special thank you to composer Jan Peters, who outdid himself with the score for this event!

notes.title: Anniversary Celebration
notes.notes:
Time flies when you're having fun! It's been a year since Cards&Crystals was released.
[b]Thank you[/b] to everyone who played, commented, reviewed and made fan art! 

Log in this weekend to claim your piece of the [b]Anniversary Cake[/b]. 
Wait any longer and the cake will have gone the way of all sweets (into Blubellie's blue bellie).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37752624/cf40b8ae5b5f2edd7f6ae0e25eea2e205fdcb6dd.png[/img]

What's in store for the future? Wait and see...

notes.title: Release v1.1.5 - Egg Hunt Update
notes.notes:
Features
* Added spring variant of the world map - with many associated changes
* Added the "Great Egg Hunt" holiday event
** Look for six eggs hidden throughout the world
** But be quick, or Blubellie gets them first
** 7 new encounters during the Easter season (Good Friday - Sunday after Easter)
** Collect 6 egg cards and a special egg basket card
* In the spirit of the season, added another very secret Easter egg

Improvements
* Added Reptile subtype to some cards
* Improved AI handling of cards that quicken cards in hand
* Cleaned up some internal logging

Fixes
* Pyramid Beetle is now an Insect, as it should be
* Fixed a bug that caused the AI to check commands on an incomplete log (causing it to never use certain abilities)

Open issues
* Show FPS options in screen resolution config

notes.title: Night of the Strange Bellies
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37752624/7bfc4c827b80df8295ba80e9c633324ff19b3ed7.png[/img]
Harvest time is upon us and spooky stuff is happening in Cards & Crystals. 
Giant pumpkins appear and strange bellies roam the lands.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37752624/35200498bdceaf72f52a5cf47bb2c1eae49c09b2.png[/img]
The ghostly Boo-Bellie will fight you with a deck of tricks and treats! 
Don't face it alone or you might just get scared to death...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37752624/e10eb6b9f3d19e26ab82063f460f60b962926c73.png[/img]
Win the special battle until November 1st and win an exclusive Harvest Lantern card. 

P.S.: And whatever you do, don't anger the Shoebellie!

notes.title: Update 1.1 Released!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37752624/745e57c9d9eeb881b62526e0b78bf2ec625dccd3.png[/img]

The [b]Puzzle Mode [/b]challenges you with 50 tricky scenarios. Use your wits to win the game before time runs out. Puzzle Mode unlooks after you reach Level 11.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37752624/6ecdb3541ec25c1afeacdb18c2b1fc56591c33de.png[/img]

Fed up with fighting your opponents' overpowered decks? Switch roles in [b]Mirror Mode[/b] and play as a god, dragon ... or a squirrel, if you're unlucky. Mirror Mode unlooks after you reach Level 22.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37752624/a7f49403bd3cdae0c6470b9729c1d64845806c4d.png[/img]

[b]Change your difficulty[/b]: Adjust the AI to take mercy on you or do her very best to ruin your day. Grind like it's free-to-play or get that whale treatment, without any additional costs of course.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37752624/4fdab5248ab86f6c05213b6502b3cfdbb3ad4235.png[/img]

Zeru, the mapmaker will help you find the opponents you want. But his help comes at a price. Look for him in the tavern after you've won a few random encounters. His maps should be a great help in the endgame.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37752624/f8be9388a5c5483d406a416b9c15b5170b5d5738.png[/img]

Over [b]20 new cards[/b] have been added to the game to offer new strategic possibilities. Many of you asked to make troops more viable in the early game and we listened. The Running Boots will help you cheat out those gods and dragons.

And that's not all:
[list]
[*]New worlmap events: Look out for new vendors that sell all kinds of cards
[*]12 new Achievements: Beat the final boss with common cards, fight to a draw or teach Blubellie a lesson in dramatic irony
[*]Two new secret game modes
[*]Quality of life improvements and bugfixes
[*]More smalltalk
[*]Over one hour of new music
[/list]

Thank you to all players - you have been awesome! Also a big thank you to Jan for creating the beautiful puzzle mode soundtrack (and testing my devious puzzles) and Eisfüchsin for helping with card illkustrations and awesome promotional artwork!
